column1: # Each FT-02 group's gzipped wasm beside the default profile's, and what
# gzip -9 makes of the group's WOFF2 forms (fallback_coverage.rs,
# npm job builds the default profile, `wasm-pack build --release --target web
# --out-dir pkg bindings/js` under `RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings`, a group's with a
# scratch feature carrying the WOFF2 forms its census `group` row counts, each
# counted by `gzip -9 -c bindings/js/pkg/tinker_pdf_js_bg.wasm | wc -c`, all of
# one revision; `forms_gzip_bytes` is the same gzip -9 over the group's forms
# joined in the census's order, `cat FORMS | gzip -9 -c | wc -c`, none for the
# default. `form`: each form alone through it. The run's revision, machine
# and day are in the message of the commit that wrote it.
